Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Both a physics teacher and a truck driver had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the physics teacher and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of heroine. After the truck driver's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who was free of drugs?
A. The physics teacher
B. Not answerable
C. The truck driver
